pillars.name: Reliability
pillars.question: Can users trust the data during a source or refresh failure?

controls.title: Measure end-to-end freshness
controls.evidence: Source watermark, refresh completion, and a visible stale-data threshold.

controls.title: Exercise recovery
controls.evidence: Restore model definitions, rebind connections, and test gateway member loss against agreed RTO/RPO.

pillars.metric: p95 data age; failed refresh rate; tested RTO/RPO

pillars.name: Security
pillars.question: Which identity can read which rows at every boundary?

controls.title: Test each authorization boundary
controls.evidence: Source roles, connection identity, semantic RLS/OLS, Viewer access, export, and Build permission tests.

controls.title: Approve identity and data movement
controls.evidence: Non-personal workload identity, credential lifecycle, TLS, DNS, approved regions, and explicit copy approval.

pillars.metric: Denied-access tests; privilege review age; credential expiry

pillars.name: Cost optimization
pillars.question: What does the complete query and refresh path cost?

controls.title: Attribute the complete BI bill
controls.evidence: Capacity + warehouse compute + billed transfer + storage + gateways + operating effort per data product.

controls.title: Set workload-specific limits
controls.evidence: Warehouse auto-suspend, statement timeouts, credit monitors, and alerts with a named responder.

pillars.metric: Cost per active consumer; credits per refresh; transferred bytes

pillars.name: Operational excellence
pillars.question: Can another engineer deploy, diagnose, and roll this back?

controls.title: Promote definitions, not credentials
controls.evidence: Versioned model/report definitions, reviewed changes, environment connection mapping, and a rollback procedure.

controls.title: Record ownership and observability
controls.evidence: Runbook, service owner, lineage, refresh/query correlation, gateway health, and actionable alerts.

pillars.metric: Change failure rate; alert-to-recovery time; owner coverage

pillars.name: Performance efficiency
pillars.question: Does the measured workload meet its interaction target?

controls.title: Benchmark the intended grain
controls.evidence: Star schema, filtered columns, query folding, source plans, and cold/warm p95 at expected concurrency.

controls.title: Observe every engine hop
controls.evidence: Aggregation hit/miss, source queue time, capacity throttling, memory, and Direct Lake fallback where applicable.

pillars.metric: p95 visual latency; source queue time; refresh peak memory

caf.name: Tenant and billing
caf.artifact: Tenant/capacity region map; cloud billing ownership; per-user licensing decision.

caf.name: Identity and access
caf.artifact: Entra groups; source role mapping; workload identity; Viewer/Build/RLS test matrix.

caf.name: Resource organization
caf.artifact: Domain ownership; dev/test/prod workspaces; subscription/account/project boundaries.

caf.name: Network and connectivity
caf.artifact: Gateway placement; private/public paths; DNS; Cloud Fetch storage reachability; TLS.

caf.name: Security baseline
caf.artifact: Data classification; approved movement; export controls; source and semantic authorization.

caf.name: Management
caf.artifact: SLOs; gateway lifecycle; capacity/warehouse telemetry; recovery exercises.

caf.name: Governance
caf.artifact: Data contracts; endorsed semantic models; lineage; access reviews; exception register.

caf.name: Platform automation
caf.artifact: Reviewed IaC; environment parameters; source-controlled definitions; release/rollback evidence.

readiness.label: Freshness, interaction latency, concurrency, RTO, and RPO are agreed.
Rows, results, caches, exports, and metadata have approved destinations.
Source identity and semantic RLS/OLS pass allowed and denied tests.
Authors, consumers, capacity features, and gateway licensing are confirmed.
DNS, TLS, warehouse endpoints, and result-storage access are tested.
Cold/warm p95, refresh memory, and source queues meet measured targets.
Compute, transfer, capacity, storage, and operations have named budgets.
Definitions are versioned; environment mapping and rollback are rehearsed.
A service owner, alert responder, and credential lifecycle are recorded.
Source outage, refresh failure, and gateway member loss are exercised.
